companion.name: Wolf
fluff: Your companion is a wolf, dog, or other canine.
companion.support: Your wolf tears tendons with each opening. Until the start of your next turn, your {@action Strike|PC1|Strikes} that damage creatures your wolf threatens give the target a −5-foot status penalty to its Speeds for 1 minute (−10 on a critical success).

maneuver.name: Takedown
maneuver.requirements: The animal companion's last action was a successful jaws {@action Strike|PC1}.
entries: The wolf automatically knocks the target of its jaws {@action Strike|PC1} {@condition prone|PC1}.

companion.name: Snake
fluff: Your companion is a constrictor snake, such as a boa or python.
companion.support: Your snake holds your enemies with its coils, interfering with reactions. Until the start of your next turn, any creature your snake threatens can't use reactions triggered by your actions unless its level is higher than yours.

maneuver.name: Constrict
maneuver.requirements: The snake has a smaller creature {@condition grabbed|PC1}.
entries: The snake deals 12 bludgeoning damage to the {@condition grabbed|PC1} creature; the creature must attempt a basic Fortitude save against your class DC. If the snake is a specialized animal companion, increase this damage to 20.

companion.name: Shark
fluff: Your companion is a shark of any kind, such as a hammerhead, great white, or jigsaw shark.
companion.special: The shark has the {@trait aquático} trait. Its blood scent enables it to smell blood in the water from up to 1 mile away.
companion.support: When your shark senses blood, it tears into your enemies. Until the start of your next turn, each time you hit a creature in the shark's reach with a {@action Strike|PC1} and deal slashing or piercing damage, the creature takes {@damage 1d8} slashing damage from the shark. If your shark is nimble or savage, the slashing damage increases to {@damage 2d8}.

maneuver.name: Shred
maneuver.requirements: The shark hit with a jaws {@action Strike|PC1} on its most recent action this turn.
entries: The shark viciously rips into the wound. The target of the shark's {@action Strike|PC1} takes {@damage 1d8} slashing damage ({@damage 2d8} for a mature shark or {@damage 3d8} for a specialized companion).

companion.name: Scorpion
fluff: Your companion is one of the various species of giant scorpion.
companion.special: The scorpion's stinger attack deals an additional {@damage 1d4} poison damage or {@damage 2d4} poison damage if the scorpion is a specialized companion.
companion.support: Your scorpion drips poison from its stinger when you create an opening. Until the start of your next turn, your {@action Strike|PC1|Strikes} that damage a creature in your scorpion's reach also deal {@damage 1d6} {@condition persistent damage|PC1|persistent poison damage}. If your scorpion is nimble or savage, the {@condition persistent damage|PC1|persistent poison damage} increases to {@damage 2d6}.

maneuver.name: Grab and Sting
entries: The scorpion holds its foe in place with its pincers in order to sting it. It makes a pincer {@action Strike|PC1}. If the {@action Strike|PC1} hits, the target creature automatically becomes {@condition grabbed|PC1} by the scorpion, which then makes a stinger {@action Strike|PC1} against it. The {@condition grabbed|PC1} condition lasts until the end of your next turn.

companion.name: Riding Drake
fluff: Your companion is a swift, flightless drake with limited intelligence, less vicious than most drakes but fiercely loyal to you. A riding drake has the {@trait dragão} trait instead of the {@trait animal} trait, but it otherwise functions normally as an animal companion.
companion.support: Your drake snorts fire in your foes' faces. Until the start of your next turn, each time you {@action Strike|PC1} while riding the drake and hit a creature in the drake's reach, the creature takes {@damage 1d4} fire damage from the drake. If your drake is nimble or savage, the fire damage increases to {@damage 2d4}.

maneuver.name: Fire Breath
entries: The riding drake breathes a 30-foot cone of fire, dealing {@damage 1d6} fire damage for every 2 levels the drake has to all creatures in the area (basic Reflex save). This uses a trained DC using the drake's Constitution modifier or an expert DC if the drake is specialized.

companion.name: Horse
fluff: Your companion is a horse, pony, or similar equine.
companion.support: Until the start of your next turn, if you're mounted on your horse and moved 10 feet or more on the action before a melee {@action Strike|PC1}, add a circumstance bonus to damage for that {@action Strike|PC1} equal to twice the number of weapon damage dice. If your weapon already has the {@trait jousting} weapon trait, increase the trait's damage bonus by 2 per die instead.

maneuver.name: Gallop
entries: The horse {@action Stride|PC1|Strides} twice at a +10-foot circumstance bonus to Speed.

companion.name: Dromaeosaur
fluff: Your companion is a dromaeosaur (also called a raptor), such as a velociraptor or deinonychus.
companion.support: Your raptor constantly darts into flanking position. Until the start of your next turn, it counts as being in its space or an empty space of your choice within 10 feet when determining whether you and your companion are flanking; you can choose a different space for each of your attacks.

maneuver.name: Darting Attack
entries: The raptor {@action Step|PC1|Steps} up to 10 feet and then {@action Strike|PC1|Strikes}, or {@action Strike|PC1|Strikes} and then {@action Step|PC1|Steps} up to 10 feet.

companion.name: Crocodile
fluff: Your companion is a crocodile or a similar crocodilian reptile, such as an alligator or caiman.
companion.special: The crocodile can hold its breath for about 2 hours.
companion.support: Your crocodile clamps its jaws on your foe, refusing to let go. Until the start of your next turn, if your {@action Strike|PC1} damages a creature in your crocodile's reach, your crocodile can latch onto the creature. While thus attached, the crocodile can move along with the target whenever the target moves until the end of your next turn. Your crocodile can latch onto only one creature in this way, and it must release the creature to make a jaws {@action Strike|PC1}. If the target is smaller than the crocodile, it takes a −10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds and can't {@action Fly|PC1} while the crocodile is latched on.

maneuver.name: Death Roll
maneuver.requirements: The crocodile has a creature {@condition grabbed|PC1}.
entries: The crocodile tucks its legs and rolls rapidly, twisting its victim. It makes a jaws {@action Strike|PC1} with a +2 circumstance bonus to the attack roll against the {@condition grabbed|PC1} creature. If it hits, it also knocks the creature {@condition prone|PC1}. If it misses, it releases the creature.

companion.name: Cat
fluff: Your companion is a big cat, such as a leopard or tiger.
companion.special: Your cat deals {@damage 1d4} extra precision damage against {@condition off-guard|PC1} targets.
companion.support: Your cat throws your enemies off-balance when you create an opening. Until the start of your next turn, your {@action Strike|PC1|Strikes} that deal damage to a creature within your cat's reach make the target {@condition off-guard|PC1} until the end of your next turn.

maneuver.name: Cat Pounce
entries: The cat {@action Stride|PC1|Strides} and then {@action Strike|PC1|Strikes}. If it was {@condition undetected|PC1} at the start of its Cat Pounce, it remains {@condition undetected|PC1} until after the attack.

companion.name: Boar
fluff: Your companion is a boar or pig.
companion.support: Your boar gores your foes. Until the start of your next turn, your {@action Strike|PC1|Strikes} that damage a creature in your boar's reach also deal {@damage 1d6} {@condition persistent damage|PC1|persistent bleed damage}. If your boar is nimble or savage, the {@condition persistent damage|PC1|persistent bleed damage} increases to {@damage 2d6}.

maneuver.name: Boar Charge
entries: The boar {@action Stride|PC1|Strides} twice in a straight line and then makes a tusk {@action Strike|PC1}. As long as it moved at least 20 feet, it gains a +2 circumstance bonus to its attack roll.

companion.name: Bird
fluff: Your companion is a bird of prey, such as an eagle, hawk, or owl.
companion.support: The bird pecks at your foes' eyes when you create an opening. Until the start of your next turn, your {@action Strike|PC1|Strikes} that damage a creature that your bird threatens also deal {@damage 1d4} {@condition persistent damage|PC1|persistent bleed damage}, and the target is {@condition dazzled|PC1} until it removes the bleed damage. If your bird is nimble or savage, the {@condition persistent damage|PC1|persistent bleed damage} increases to {@damage 2d4}.

maneuver.name: Flyby Attack
entries: The bird {@action Fly|PC1|Flies} and makes a talon {@action Strike|PC1} at any point along the way.

companion.name: Bear
fluff: Your companion is a black, grizzly, polar, or other type of bear.
companion.support: Your bear mauls your enemies when you create an opening. Until the start of your next turn, each time you hit a creature in the bear's reach with a {@action Strike|PC1}, the creature takes {@damage 1d8} slashing damage from the bear. If your bear is nimble or savage, the slashing damage increases to {@damage 2d8}.

maneuver.name: Bear Hug
maneuver.requirements: The bear's last action was a successful claw {@action Strike|PC1}.
entries: The bear makes another claw {@action Strike|PC1} against the same target. If this {@action Strike|PC1} hits, the target is also {@condition grabbed|PC1}, as if the bear had successfully {@action Grapple|PC1|Grappled} the target.

companion.name: Bat
fluff: Your companion is a particularly large bat, such as a giant bat.

other: echolocation 20 feet (the bat can use hearing as a precise sense within this range)

companion.support: Your bat flaps around your foes' arms and faces, getting in the way of their attacks. Until the start of your next turn, creatures in your bat's reach that you damage with {@action Strike|PC1|Strikes} take a −1 circumstance penalty to their attack rolls.

maneuver.name: Wing Thrash
entries: The bat thrashes wildly with its wings, making wing {@action Strike|PC1|Strikes} against up to three adjacent foes. Each attack counts toward the bat's multiple attack penalty, but the penalty only increases after all the attacks have been made.

companion.name: Ape
fluff: Your companion is an ape or other primate.
companion.support: Your ape threatens your foes with menacing growls. Until the start of your next turn, if you hit and deal damage to a creature in your ape's reach, the creature becomes {@condition frightened|PC1|frightened 1}.

maneuver.name: Frightning Display
entries: Your ape makes a loud and frightening display, throwing a foe off balance. The ape attempts to {@action Demoralize|PC1} the target creature; this display gains the {@trait visual} trait and doesn't require language. While frightened by this ability, the target is {@condition off-guard|PC1} to your ape.

companion.name: Arboreal Sapling
fluff: Your companion is a walking tree, a cousin of the great arboreal wardens and regents. An arboreal sapling has the {@trait plant} trait instead of the {@trait animal} trait, but it otherwise functions normally as an animal companion. They are typically only selected by {@class druid|PC1|animal order druids|animal} who are also members of the {@class druid|PC1|leaf order|leaf}.
companion.access: You are a member of the {@class druid|PC1|leaf order|leaf}.
companion.support: Your arboreal sapling plants roots around your foe, impeding its movement. Until the start of your next turn, if you hit and deal damage to a creature in your arboreal sapling's reach, the first square the creature moves into after taking that damage is {@quickref difficult terrain|PC1|3|terrain}.

maneuver.name: Throw Rock
entries: The arboreal sapling {@action Interact|PC1|Interacts} to pick up a rock within reach or retrieve a stowed rock, then throws it with a ranged rock Strike that deals {@damage 2d6} bludgeoning ({@damage 3d6} for a specialized companion) damage with a range increment of 30 feet.

companion.name: Badger
fluff: Your companion is a badger, wolverine, or other big mustelid.
companion.support: Your badger digs around your foe's position, interfering with its footing. Until the start of your next turn, if you hit and deal damage to a creature your badger threatens, the target can't use a {@action Step|PC1} action (unless it can {@action Step|PC1} through {@quickref difficult terrain|PC1|3|terrain}) until it moves from its current position.

maneuver.name: Badger Rage
maneuver.requirements: The badger isn't {@condition fatigued|PC1} or raging.
entries: The badger enters a state of pure rage that lasts for 1 minute, until there are no enemies it can perceive, or until it falls {@condition unconscious|PC1}, whichever comes first. It can't voluntarily stop raging. While raging, the badger is affected in the following ways.

items: It deals 4 additional damage with its bite attacks and 2 additional damage with its claw attacks.
It takes a −1 penalty to AC
It can't use actions that have the {@trait concentrate} trait. The animal companion can {@action Seek|PC1} even while raging.

entries: After it has stopped raging, it can't use Badger Rage again for 1 minute.

companionAbility.name: Ambusher
entries: In your companion's natural environment, it can use a {@action Sneak|PC1} action even if it's currently {@condition observed|PC1}. Its proficiency rank in {@skill Stealth|PC1} increases to expert (or master if it was already an expert from its type), and its Dexterity modifier increases by 1. Its proficiency rank for unarmored defense increases to expert.

companionAbility.name: Bully
entries: Your companion terrorizes foes with dominance displays and pushes them around the battlefield. Its proficiency ranks for {@skill Athletics|PC1} and {@skill Intimidation|PC1} increase to expert (or master if it was already expert from its type), its Strength modifier increases by 1, and its Charisma modifier increases by 3.

companionAbility.name: Daredevil
entries: Your companion joins the fray with graceful leaps and dives. It gains the deny advantage ability, so it isn't {@condition off-guard|PC1} to {@condition hidden|PC1}, {@condition undetected|PC1}, or {@condition flanking|PC1} creatures unless such a creature's level is greater than yours. Its proficiency rank in {@skill Acrobatics|PC1} increases to master, and its Dexterity modifier increases by 1. Its proficiency rank in unarmored defense increases to expert.

companionAbility.name: Racer
entries: Your companion races. It gains a +10-foot status bonus to its Speed, swim Speed, or fly Speed (your choice). Its proficiency in Fortitude saves increases to legendary, and its Constitution modifier increases by 1.

companionAbility.name: Tracker
entries: Your companion is an incredible tracker. It can move at full Speed while following tracks. Its proficiency rank in {@skill Survival|PC1} increases to expert (or master if it was already an expert from its type), and its Wisdom modifier increases by 1.

companionAbility.name: Wrecker
entries: Your companion smashes things. Its unarmed attacks ignore half an object's Hardness. Its {@skill Athletics|PC1} proficiency increases to master, and its Strength modifier increases by 1.

companionAbility.name: Mature
entries: When you advance a young animal companion to a mature animal companion:

items: If your companion is Medium or smaller, it grows by one size.
Increase its Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, and Wisdom modifiers by 1.

Increase its proficiency rank for {@skill Perception|PC1} and all saving throws to expert. Increase its proficiency ranks in {@skill Intimidation|PC1}, {@skill Stealth|PC1}, and {@skill Survival|PC1} to trained, and if it was already trained in one of those skills from its type, increase its proficiency rank in that skill to expert.
Increase its unarmed attack damage from one die to two dice (for instance {@damage 1d8} to {@damage 2d8}).

companionAbility.name: Nimble
entries: To advance a {@companionAbility mature|PC1} animal companion to a nimble animal companion:

items: Increase its Dexterity modifier by 2 and its Strength, Constitution, and Wisdom modifiers by 1.
Increase its proficiency ranks in {@skill Acrobatics|PC1} to expert.
It deals 2 additional damage with its unarmed attacks. Its attacks become {@trait mágico} for the purpose of ignoring resistances.
It learns the advanced maneuver for its type.

companionAbility.name: Savage
entries: To advance a {@companionAbility mature|PC1} animal companion to a savage animal companion:

items: If your companion is Medium or smaller, it grows by one size.
Increase its Strength modifier by 2 and its Dexterity, Constitution, and Wisdom modifiers by 1.
Increase its proficiency rank in {@skill Athletics|PC1} to expert.
It deals 3 additional damage with its unarmed attacks. Its attacks become {@trait mágico} for the purpose of ignoring resistances.
It learns the advanced maneuver for its type.

familiarAbility.name: Amphibious
entries: It gains the {@trait anfíbio} trait, allowing it to breathe in both air and water, and has both a land Speed and a swim Speed, each equal to its highest land Speed or swim Speed.

familiarAbility.name: Burrower
entries: It gains a burrow Speed of 5 feet, allowing it to dig Tiny holes.

familiarAbility.name: Climber
entries: It gains a climb Speed of 25 feet.

familiarAbility.name: Darkvision
entries: It gains darkvision.

familiarAbility.name: Echolocation
entries: Your pet can use hearing as a precise sense within 20 feet.

familiarAbility.name: Fast Movement
entries: Increase one of the pet's Speeds from 25 feet to 40 feet.

familiarAbility.name: Flier
entries: It gains a fly Speed of 25 feet.

familiarAbility.name: Manual Dexterity
entries: It can use up to two of its limbs as if they were hands to perform manipulate actions.

familiarAbility.name: Scent
entries: Your pet can use scent as an imprecise sense within 30 feet

familiarAbility.name: Tough
entries: Your pet's max HP increase by 2 per level.

familiarAbility.name: Accompanist
entries: Your familiar helps you perform. Whenever you attempt a {@skill Performance|PC1} check, if your familiar is nearby and can act, it accompanies you with chirps, claps, or its own miniature instrument. This grants you a +1 circumstance bonus, or +2 if you're a master in {@skill Performance|PC1}.

familiarAbility.name: Construct
entries: Your familiar has the {@trait construto} trait instead of the {@trait animal} trait. The familiar is immune to death effects, {@condition disease|PC1}, {@condition doomed|PC1}, {@condition drained|PC1}, {@condition fatigued|PC1}, {@trait cura}, {@trait nonlethal} attacks, {@condition paralyzed|PC1}, {@trait poison}, {@condition sickened|PC1}, {@trait espiritual}, {@condition unconscious|PC1}, {@trait vitality}, and {@trait eversão}. Your familiar must have the tough {@feat pet|PC1} ability to select this.

familiarAbility.name: Damage Avoidance
entries: Choose one type of save. Your familiar takes no damage when it rolls a success on that type of save; this doesn't prevent effects other than damage.

familiarAbility.name: Dragon
entries: Your familiar has the {@trait dragão} trait instead of the {@trait animal} trait.

familiarAbility.name: Elemental
entries: Your familiar has the {@trait elemental} trait instead of the {@trait animal} trait. Choose {@trait ar}, {@trait earth}, {@trait fogo}, {@trait metal}, {@trait água}, or {@trait wood}. Your familiar gains that trait. The familiar is immune to {@condition persistent damage|PC1|bleed}, {@condition paralyzed|PC1}, {@condition poison|PC1}, {@condition sleep|PC1}, and the element matching its trait. Your familiar must have the {@familiarAbility resistance|PC1} familiar ability to select this.

familiarAbility.name: Focused Rejuvenation
entries: When you {@action Refocus|PC1}, you generate magical energy that heals your familiar. Your familiar regains 1 Hit Point per level whenever you {@action Refocus|PC1}.

familiarAbility.name: Fungus
entries: Your familiar has the {@trait fungo} trait instead of the {@trait animal} trait.

familiarAbility.name: Independent
entries: In an encounter, if you don't {@action Command an Animal|PC1|Command} your familiar, it still gains 1 action each round. Typically, you still decide how it spends that action, but, the GM might determine that your familiar chooses its own tactics rather than performing your preferred action. This doesn't work with {@familiarAbility valet|PC1} or similar abilities that require a command, if you're capable of riding your familiar, or similar situations.

familiarAbility.name: Kinspeech
entries: Your familiar can understand and speak with animals of the same species. To select this, your familiar must be an {@trait animal}, it must have the {@familiarAbility speech|PC1} ability, and you must be at least 6th level.

familiarAbility.name: Major Resistance
entries: Your familiar increases the resistance it gains from its {@familiarAbility resistance|PC1} familiar ability to a value equal to your level. To select this you must be at least 8th level.

familiarAbility.name: Master's Form
entries: Your familiar can change shape as a single action, transforming into a humanoid of your ancestry with the same age, gender, and build of its true form, though it always maintains a clearly unnatural remnant of its nature, such as a cat's eyes or a serpent's tongue. This form is always the same each time it uses this ability. This otherwise uses the effects of humanoid form, except the change is purely cosmetic. It only appears humanoid and gains no new capabilities. Your familiar must have the {@familiarAbility manual dexterity|PC1} and {@familiarAbility speech|PC1} abilities to select this.

familiarAbility.name: Partner in Crime
entries: Your familiar is your criminal associate. Despite being a {@trait minion}, your familiar gains 1 reaction at the start of its turns, which it can use only to {@action Aid|PC1} you on a {@skill Deception|PC1} or {@skill Thievery|PC1} skill check (it still has to prepare to help you as normal for the {@action Aid|PC1} reaction). It automatically succeeds at its check to {@action Aid|PC1} you with those skills or automatically critically succeeds if you're a master of the skill in question.

familiarAbility.name: Plant
entries: Your familiar has the {@trait plant} trait instead of the {@trait animal} trait.

familiarAbility.name: Plant Form
entries: Your plant familiar can change shape as a single action, transforming into a Tiny plant of a type roughly similar to the familiar's nature. This otherwise uses the effects of one with plants. You must have a familiar with the {@trait plant} trait to select this ability.

familiarAbility.name: Resistance
entries: Choose two of the following: acid, cold, electricity, fire, poison, or sonic. Your familiar gains resistance equal to half your level (minimum resistance 1) against the chosen damage types.

familiarAbility.name: Skilled
entries: Choose a skill other than {@skill Acrobatics|PC1} or {@skill Stealth|PC1}. Your familiar's modifier for that skill is equal to your level plus your spellcasting attribute modifier, rather than just your level. You can select this ability repeatedly, choosing a different skill each time.

familiarAbility.name: Speech
entries: Your familiar understands and speaks a language you know.

familiarAbility.name: Spellcasting
entries: Choose a spell in your repertoire or that you prepared today at least 5 levels lower than your highest-rank spell slot. Your familiar can Cast that Spell once per day using your magical tradition, spell attack modifier, and spell DC. If the spell has a drawback that affects the caster, both you and your familiar are affected. You must be able to cast 6th-rank spells using spell slots to select this.

familiarAbility.name: Toolbearer
entries: Your familiar can carry a toolkit of up to light Bulk. So long as your familiar is adjacent to you, you can draw and replace the tools as part of the action that uses them as if you were wearing them. Your familiar must have the {@familiarAbility manual dexterity|PC1} ability to select this.

familiarAbility.name: Touch Telepathy
entries: Your familiar can telepathically communicate with you via touch. If it also has the {@familiarAbility speech|PC1} ability, it can telepathically communicate via touch with any creature if they share a language.

familiarAbility.name: Valet
entries: You can command your familiar to deliver you items more efficiently. Your familiar doesn't use its 2 actions immediately upon your command. Instead, up to twice before the end of your turn, you can have your familiar {@action Interact|PC1} to retrieve an item of light or negligible Bulk you are wearing and place it into one of your free hands. The familiar can't use this ability to retrieve stowed items. If the familiar has a different number of actions, it can retrieve one item for each action it has when commanded this way.

familiarAbility.name: Absorb Familiar
entries: Your familiar can transform into a mark you carry on your flesh, typically seeming like a birthmark, tattoo, or gem that vaguely resembles its normal form. When transformed, the familiar can't act except to turn back into a familiar. It isn't affected by area effects and must be targeted separately to affect it, which requires knowledge that it's a creature. This means you and your allies can heal or assist the familiar while most enemies stay unaware of its true nature. Creatures must attempt a DC 20 {@skill Perception|PC1} check to {@action Seek|PC1} to realize a it is actually a familiar. Your familiar can still communicate its feelings empathically. Transforming the familiar between forms is a 1-minute activity that has the {@trait concentrate} trait.

familiarAbility.name: Cantrip Connection
entries: You can prepare an additional {@trait cantrip} or, if you have a repertoire, designate a {@trait cantrip} to add to your repertoire every time you select this ability; you can retrain it but can't otherwise change it. You must be able to prepare {@trait cantrip||cantrips} or add them to your repertoire to select this.

familiarAbility.name: Familiar Focus
entries: Once per day, your familiar can use 2 actions with the {@trait concentrate} trait to restore 1 Focus Point to your focus pool, up to your usual maximum. You must have a focus pool to select this.

familiarAbility.name: Innate Surge
entries: Once per day, you can draw upon your familiar's innate magic to replenish your own. You can cast one innate spell gained from an ancestry feat that you have already cast today. You must still Cast the Spell and meet the spell's other requirements.

familiarAbility.name: Lifelink
entries: If your familiar would be reduced to 0 HP by damage, as a reaction with the {@trait concentrate} trait, you can take all the damage, and your familiar takes none. However, special effects that would occur due to that damage (such as snake venom) still apply.

familiarAbility.name: Share Senses
entries: Once every 10 minutes, you can use a single action with the {@trait concentrate} trait to project your senses into your familiar. When you do, you lose all sensory information from your own body, but can sense through your familiar's body for up to 1 minute. You can {@action Dismiss|PC1} this effect.

familiarAbility.name: Spell Battery
entries: You gain one additional spell slot at least 3 ranks lower than your highest-rank spell slot; you must be able to cast 4th-rank spells using spell slots to select this master ability.

familiarAbility.name: Spell Delivery
entries: If your familiar is in your space, you can cast a spell with a range of touch, transfer its power to your familiar, and command the familiar to deliver the spell. If you do, the familiar uses its 2 actions for the round to move to a target of your choice and touch that target. If it doesn't reach the target to touch it this turn, the spell has no effect.

familiarAbility.name: Recall Familiar
entries: Once per day, you can use a 3-action activity, which has the {@trait concentrate} trait, to teleport your familiar to your space. Your familiar must be within 1 mile or the attempt to summon it fails. This is a {@trait teleportation} effect.

familiarAbility.name: Restorative Familiar
entries: Once per day, your familiar can use 2 actions with the {@trait concentrate} trait to give up some of its energy and heal you. It must be in your space to do so. You restore a number of Hit Points equal to {@dice 1d8} times half your level (minimum {@dice 1d8}).
